item.title: National Clinical Labour Market Intelligence
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: complete Deadline: 2026-09-14T17:00:00+01:00
Ingeus is seeking suitably experienced suppliers to provide labour market intelligence that provides real-time geographical, talent and competitor insights.
We are looking to partner with a provider of market intelligence within the *clinical labour market to support our existing candidate attraction and resourcing strategy.
*specifically: Registered Occupational Therapists, Nurses, Paramedics, Physiotherapists and Pharmacists.
Suppliers wishing to be considered should submit a short written response setting out: • Detailed scope of market intelligence offered. • Geographies it relates to. • Clinical professions it relates to. • Cost model.
Responses and any enquiries should be submitted by email by the closing date stated above, with "National Clinical Labour Market Intelligence" in the subject field
Additional information: Ingeus reserves the right to: • award contracts to one or more suppliers • separate or combine work packages • withdraw or amend this opportunity
Feedback will not be provided to unsuccessful respondents.

item.title: CA18634 - RFQ 2026/46 - NMANDD PEACEPLUS "Thriving Together" - Celebrating Cultures and Diversity - 3.2 Creative Language Exchange
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 10,154 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-01T12:00:00Z
Competent and creative suppliers are hereby invited to tender for the design, development, and delivery of an engaging Creative language exchange programme. The project will deliver an inclusive Creative Language Exchange programme that uses music and cultural sharing to bring people together. Participants will learn songs in different languages, explore diverse cultures, and share their own experiences in a welcoming environment. Working towards a public performance, the programme will celebrate linguistic and cultural diversity while promoting inclusion, intercultural understanding, and belonging. The programme aims to strengthen community connections, support the integration of minority communities, and build more inclusive and cohesive communities across the district.
To access this competition:
Registered: Login to https://suppliers.multiquote.com and view the opportunity CA18634.
Not registered: Visit https://suppliers.multiquote.com then register and quote CA18634 as the reason for registration.
Any queries please contact MultiQuote on 020 3920 8054.

item.title: Award of a call off contract under the Prison Education Dynamic Purchasing System for CSCS Card provision for prisoners at HMP Winchester
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 23,040 Status: complete Deadline: 2026-10-08T15:00:00+01:00
Award of a call off contract under the Prison Education Dynamic Purchasing System for CSCS Card provision for prisoners at HMP Winchester. The supplier shall deliver a CSCS Card (Green - Labourer/Site Operative) course to meet the specific needs of the prisoners at HMP Winchester. The course shall incorporate a wide range of styles of differentiated learning methods. The course shall be designed to help prisoners meet the required standards to obtain a CSCS Card (Green Labourer/Site Operative), when they are assigned the construction pathway. It should also be designed to encourage and promote personal development and devise practical, creative and innovative methods for personal growth and behavioural change and enable employment in the construction sector on release.

item.title: Legionella Remedials
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 19,700 Status: complete Deadline: 2026-04-27T00:00:00+01:00
MSV are looking to employ the services of suitably qualified and experienced contractors to tender for the provision of Legionella remedial works across its housing stock. These works will address non-compliances and remedial actions identified during Legionella Risk Assessments and ongoing monitoring visits, in line with ACOP L8, HSG274 Parts 1-3, and other applicable water hygiene standards. This tender exercise is being procured via the contractor DPS - Lot 13 - Compliance - Legionella Monitoring. Contract duration will be for a period of 12 months with an option for a further 12 months based on satisfactory performance.
